ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "client_secret" : p('mongo-db-sapi.security.client-secret'), "client_id" : p('mongo-db-sapi.security.client-id'), "X-CORRELATION-ID": attributes.headers.'x-correlation-id' default correlationId, "name": attributes.headers.name, "systemId": attributes.headers.systemId, "source": attributes.headers.source }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "documentNumber": payload.documentNumber, "documentType": payload.documentType as String }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "SendType": vars.initialPayload.sendType default 1, "DocumentType": vars.initialPayload.documentType match { case "CC" -> 1 case "CE" -> 2 else -> "Invalid input" }, "DocumentNumber": vars.initialPayload.documentNumber, "DateExpedition": (vars.initialPayload.dateExpedition as Date) as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd" }, "Surname": vars.initialPayload.firstLastName, ("Cellphone": vars.initialPayload.cellphone) if (vars.initialPayload.cellphone? and !isEmpty(vars.initialPayload.cellphone)), ("Email": vars.initialPayload.email) if (vars.initialPayload.email? and !isEmpty(vars.initialPayload.email)), "Adviser": vars.initialPayload.adviser, "Channel": vars.initialPayload.channel, "Provider": vars.initialPayload.provider, "Portal": vars.initialPayload.portal }

os:store.doc:name: store validation values
os:store.os:value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { identityId: vars.rsLisim.id, documentNumber: vars.initialPayload.documentNumber, documentType: vars.initialPayload.documentType, technology: vars.initialPayload.model.technology, segment: vars.initialPayload.model.segment }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "200", message: vars.rsLisim.cause default vars.rsLisim.message default "validacion exitosa", result: { "id": vars.rsLisim.id default "", "type": vars.rsLisim."type" default "", "questions": vars.rsLisim.questions default "", "otpCode": vars.rsLisim.otpCode default "", "matchType": vars.rsLisim.matchType default "" } }
